summary: Inspected 20+ files across move_sui (links, proofs, simulations, translations) and ruint directories. All files contain formal mathematical content: inductive types, records, definitions, lemmas (many Admitted), axioms, parameters, executable specifications, and trait implementations. Even the smallest files (e.g., language_storage.v: 12 lines with Parameter, lib.v: 27 lines with Inductive, mutual/lib.v: 38 lines with Map/Set definitions, internals.v: 7 lines with Module declaration) declare formal content. Translations are massive auto-generated formal specs of Rust traits. Proofs contain validity predicates and proof skeletons. Simulations provide executable models. Links connect translations to simulations. No file meets FILTER-004 hard-exclusion criteria (prover-aware check showing no formal math). No pure-import aggregators per FILTER-007. Default retain per FILTER-025.
